name: Bakken East Pipeline / Jamestown to Ellendale Lateral
researcher_notes: This is a branch line of the Bakken East Pipeline (P8096) that the 374 miles on that row leave out. It has no row of its own, so it is a new row under the same pipeline name. The EIA August 2026 release, Natural Gas Pipeline Projects sheet, Excel row 12, says the project also extends from Jamestown to Ellendale via 90 miles of lateral pipeline, status pre-applied, FERC pre-filing docket PF26-4, and names WBI Energy Transmission as the sponsor. An Industrial Info article from May 2026 calls it a planned branch line from the Bakken East Pipeline to the Applied Digital data center at Ellendale, and says Applied Digital is considering its own 300 MW gas plant fed by a southern lateral from the Jamestown area to Ellendale. That article supports the data center tag. A Pipeline and Gas Journal article from November 2025 says the project would carry gas to Mapleton and Ellendale for power generation and data center demand, with construction planned from 2028. The company project page was checked and does not mention Ellendale, so it is not cited. The pre-filing request covers the whole project including this lateral, which meets the concrete step test. Not found: diameter, capacity, cost, and a lateral-specific start year (the 2029 in service date in EIA is for phase 1 of the main line). Route not found, no official map seen. Owner is spelled as on P8096; the entity is not in the gazetteer under the full name, so confirm it. Parent not researched. Tier medium because length comes from one source, EIA, and the lateral is only described in one sentence there; the second source confirms existence and data center link but gives no length.
